a.title: the surprise
a.hook: you're throwing jada a surprise party. she just told {partner} she hates surprises.
openingLines: the balloons are in your closet.
a.setting: A college town in early spring, two days before Jada's twentieth birthday. You're in your dorm room with a closet full of party supplies.
a.tone: warm, chaotic, funny: two friends trying to do something nice and getting it wrong

self.description: Nineteen, the planner of the group, already paid the deposit on the back room at the taco place.
self.want: To pull off one perfect night for Jada.
self.avoids: Admitting the party is a little bit for you too.

cast.name: {partner}
cast.description: Your partner in the plan, the one who's closest to Jada, and the worst liar you know.
cast.want: For Jada to have a good birthday, whatever that turns out to be.
cast.avoids: Being the one who ruins the surprise, or the one who keeps it.
cast.closeness: you've done everything together since orientation
cast.tension: they think you never ask what anyone else wants

cast.name: Jada
cast.description: Your friend since freshman year, loves a plan as long as she's the one making it.
cast.want: A quiet birthday with the people she loves.
cast.avoids: Telling you no to your face.
cast.voiceTone: dry, all lowercase, too many ellipses
cast.closeness: close, but she tells {partner} things first
cast.tension: she's been weird since you mentioned 'saturday plans'

opening.title: The plan
opening.description: Three weeks of planning, a group chat Jada isn't in, and a deposit you can't get back.

opening.title: The slip
opening.description: Jada asked you what you're doing Saturday, and you said 'nothing' too fast.

opening.title: The text
opening.description: {partner} texts you at 10:14: 'we need to talk about saturday. she told me something.'

background: Jada had a surprise party at sixteen that ended with her crying in a bathroom.
{partner} has known about that party for a year and never told you.

b.title: the surprise
b.hook: jada just told you she hates surprises. {partner} is throwing her one saturday.
b.setting: A college town in early spring, two days before Jada's twentieth birthday. You're on the floor of your room, phone hot against your ear.
b.tone: warm, chaotic, funny: two friends trying to do something nice and getting it wrong

self.description: Nineteen, the one everyone tells things to, and terrible at keeping a straight face.
self.want: For Jada to have a birthday she actually likes.
self.avoids: Choosing between your two best friends.

cast.name: {partner}
cast.description: The planner, three weeks deep in a surprise party for Jada, already paid the deposit.
cast.want: To pull off one perfect night for Jada.
cast.avoids: Hearing that the plan is wrong.
cast.closeness: you've done everything together since orientation
cast.tension: they never ask what anyone else wants

cast.name: Jada
cast.description: Your friend since freshman year, who just told you, quietly, that surprise parties make her feel sick.
cast.want: A quiet birthday with the people she loves.
cast.voiceTone: dry, all lowercase, too many ellipses
cast.tension: she can tell you're hiding something

opening.title: The group chat
opening.description: You're in a group chat Jada isn't in, full of party plans.

opening.title: The call
opening.description: Jada calls to vent and says, out of nowhere, 'if anyone ever throws me a surprise party i'll move away.'

opening.title: The text
opening.description: At 10:14 you text {partner}: 'we need to talk about saturday. she told me something.'

background: Jada had a surprise party at sixteen that ended with her crying in a bathroom.
You've known about that party for a year and never told {partner}.
